bodyWidth.doc: Overall width of the bus, without mirrors.
bodyWidth.source: Maximum width of road vehicles in the EU (Directive 96/53/EC)

bodyHeight.doc: Height of the bus from the road to the roof.

rearOverhang.doc: Distance from the rear axle to the back of the bus; the rear axle is the reference point of the bus.

wheelbase.doc: Distance between the front and the rear axle; sets the turning radius.

frontDoorSetback.doc: Distance from the front of the bus to the middle of the front door, which must face the stop.

texturePixelsPerMetre.doc: Pixel density of the bus pixel-art textures.

maxSpeed.source: French urban speed limit (Code de la route, art. R413-3)

acceleration.doc: Forward acceleration from standstill; it falls to zero at the top speed.

reverseAcceleration.doc: Acceleration in reverse (brake key held at standstill).

rollingDeceleration.doc: Deceleration when coasting (no key pressed), before air drag.

airDrag.doc: Coasting deceleration added per square of speed (deceleration = airDrag × v²).

slopeFactor.doc: Share of the gravity along the slope felt by the bus; below 1 to keep hills drivable.

maxSteer.doc: Largest front wheel angle at low speed (turning radius about 8.5 m with the wheelbase).

steerReductionAtMaxSpeed.doc: Share of the largest wheel angle removed at top speed (linear in speed).

steerRate.doc: Speed at which the wheels turn while a steering key is held.

steerReturnRate.doc: Speed at which the wheels come back to centre once the steering keys are released.

bumpRebound.doc: Share of the speed kept, backwards, after hitting a building.

bumpCooldown.doc: Shortest time between two reported collisions.

stepsPerSecond.doc: Fixed rate of the driving and service simulation, independent of the display rate.

laneOffset.doc: Distance to the right of the route centre line where the bus starts and where the autopilot drives.

stopDistance.doc: Largest distance between the front door and the stop for the stop to be served.

stopSpeed.doc: The bus must be slower than this for the doors to open.

doorTime.doc: Time spent at a stop with the doors open; the bus is held still meanwhile.

missedStopDistance.doc: A stop the bus passes by more than this distance along the route is missed.

offRouteDistance.doc: Distance from the route beyond which the bus is off route.

offRouteDelay.doc: Time off route before the warning shows.

onTimeTolerance.doc: A stop served within this delay of its timetable is on time; the SAE colours larger delays.

saeDeltaThreshold.doc: The SAE shows the delay or advance once it exceeds this value, else 'on time'.

distance.doc: HD-2D view: distance from the camera to its target.

pitch.doc: HD-2D view: angle of the camera above the horizon.

fov.doc: HD-2D view: vertical field of view.

ahead.doc: HD-2D view: the target is this far in front of the bus centre.

followTime.doc: HD-2D view: time constant of the camera turning after the bus heading.

focus.doc: HD-2D view: height of the sharp band of the tilt-shift blur, from the bottom of the screen.

blur.doc: HD-2D view: largest tilt-shift blur radius, in internal pixels.

distance.doc: Chase view: distance from the camera to its target.

pitch.doc: Chase view: angle of the camera above the horizon.

fov.doc: Chase view: vertical field of view.

ahead.doc: Chase view: the target is this far in front of the bus centre.

followTime.doc: Chase view: time constant of the camera turning after the bus heading.

focus.doc: Chase view: height of the sharp band of the tilt-shift blur, from the bottom of the screen.

blur.doc: Chase view: largest tilt-shift blur radius, in internal pixels.

distance.doc: Sky view: distance from the camera to its target.

pitch.doc: Sky view: angle of the camera above the horizon.

fov.doc: Sky view: vertical field of view.

ahead.doc: Sky view: the target is this far in front of the bus centre.

followTime.doc: Sky view: time constant of the camera turning after the bus heading.

focus.doc: Sky view: height of the sharp band of the tilt-shift blur, from the bottom of the screen.

blur.doc: Sky view: largest tilt-shift blur radius, in internal pixels.

targetHeight.doc: Height of the camera target above the road.

groundClearance.doc: The camera never goes lower than this above the ground under it.

zoomMin.doc: Closest mouse wheel zoom, as a share of the view distance.

zoomMax.doc: Farthest mouse wheel zoom, as a multiple of the view distance.

zoomPerWheelUnit.doc: Zoom speed: the distance is multiplied by exp(zoomPerWheelUnit × wheel delta).

yawPerPixel.doc: Free camera: turn around the bus per pixel of horizontal mouse drag.

pitchPerPixel.doc: Free camera: change of pitch per pixel of vertical mouse drag.

pitchMin.doc: Free camera: lowest pitch, kept above the horizon.

pitchMax.doc: Free camera: highest pitch, kept short of straight down.

returnTime.doc: Free camera: time constant of the return to the automatic view.

returnDone.doc: Free camera: the return is complete below this angle.

internalLines.doc: Height of the internal image; it is scaled up to the screen with visible pixels (HD-2D look).

tiltShiftBand.doc: Half height of the sharp band of the tilt-shift blur.

viewDistance.doc: Farthest distance drawn; the sky dome sits just inside it.

fogColor.doc: Colour of the fog and of the sky at the horizon.

fogFar.doc: Distance where the fog hides everything.

skyTopColor.doc: Colour of the sky at the zenith.

skyMiddleColor.doc: Colour of the sky halfway up.

skyLightIntensity.doc: Intensity of the ambient light from the sky and the ground.

sunAzimuth.doc: Direction of the sun, clockwise from north (215° = south-west, afternoon).

sunElevation.doc: Height of the sun above the horizon.

shadowRadius.doc: Half side of the square around the bus where shadows are drawn.

roadLift.doc: Height of the road mesh above the shaped ground; road pieces are coplanar with the ground (tools/streets.py), the lift only avoids depth fighting.

kerbHeight.doc: Height of the sidewalks above the ground: a low kerb, readable at the HD-2D resolution.

markingLift.doc: Height of the road markings above the road.

markingWidth.doc: Width of the centre lines, wider than real ones to stay visible at the HD-2D resolution.

dashLength.doc: Length of a dash of the centre lines.

dashGap.doc: Gap between two dashes of the centre lines.

deckCatch.doc: A bus closer than this to a bridge deck height drives on the deck; farther below, it drives under it.

deepColor.doc: Colour of the water seen from above, before the sky reflection.

foamColor.doc: Colour of the foam along the banks.

quayColor.doc: Colour of the stone quay walls along the banks.

pixelSize.doc: Size of the pixels of the ripple and foam pattern, fixed in the world.

rippleSpeed.doc: Speed of the ripple animation (0 freezes it).

foamWidth.doc: Width of the foam band along the banks.

wallDepth.doc: Depth of the quay walls below the water surface.

turboMaxSpeed.doc: Debug mode: top speed with the turbo (Shift held).

turboFactor.doc: Debug mode: acceleration and braking multiplier of the turbo.

flySpeed.doc: Debug mode: speed of the free-flying camera.

flyFastFactor.doc: Debug mode: speed multiplier of the free-flying camera with Shift held.

flyMinHeight.doc: Debug mode: the free-flying camera stays this high above the ground.
